notes:
REF-BM-02: Metadata collection handles title, description, and favicon, but not preview images.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, description, and tags are editable, but notes are unsupported.
REF-BM-06: Saving an existing URL creates another bookmark without duplicate detection or edit guidance.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry is a plain text field with no existing-tag autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, URL, description, and tags, but there is no note field to search.
REF-BM-14: #tag syntax is not parsed and therefore does not match stored tags.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesized search expressions are unsupported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are not parsed as exact matches.
REF-BM-17: Bookmarks have no unread/read-later state.
REF-BM-18: There is no unread-only view.
REF-BM-19: There is no action to mark a bookmark read.
REF-BM-20: Multiple selection and bulk actions are absent.
REF-BM-21: No action can target the entire currently filtered collection.
REF-BM-23: Markdown notes and rendered note views are absent.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshot preservation is absent.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is absent.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are absent.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is absent.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is absent.
REF-BM-32: The Settings control is nonfunctional and no personal display settings are implemented.
